title: Phase 1: Capture
goal: Turn a messy pile of invoice documents into a trusted structured invoice record.
unlocks: A validated invoice record that duplicate detection and matching both reuse.

title: Phase 2: Reference Data
goal: Bring in the governed references the match depends on: vendor master, PO register, receipts, tolerances, and the paid-invoice baseline.
unlocks: The reference data the matching engine and the run can trust.

title: Phase 3: Matching
goal: Dedupe against history and match each invoice to its PO and receipt within tolerance, then route it.
unlocks: A routing decision that sends clean invoices to auto-approval and the rest to exceptions.

title: Phase 4: Exceptions and Approval
goal: Clear exceptions, log auto-approvals, assemble the batch, and capture the manager's sign-off.
unlocks: An approved payment batch ready to become the 3:00 PM run.

title: Phase 5: Payment and Archive
goal: Assemble the traceable payment run, notify vendors, and archive the run to seed tomorrow.
unlocks: The delivered, archived payment run that seeds tomorrow's duplicate baseline.
